rules.name: full_file_devotion
rules.intervention: Use grep to locate the anchor and read only the relevant section, not the whole file.

rules.name: local_loop
rules.intervention: Stop re-running locally; deploy to a cloud preview and verify there.

rules.name: blind_retry
rules.intervention: Add a diagnosis step before retrying; cap brute retries at 2.

rules.name: context_hoarding
rules.intervention: Clear or summarize context periodically; do not carry the whole history every turn.

rules.name: sticky_command
rules.intervention: One command block per atomic step; do not chain multiple commands in one block.
